`04_deletions_7b.jsonl` with `protocol`, `pilot_id`, `claim_id`, `proposition`, `original_explanation`,
`deleted_text`, `removes_claim`, `preserves_other_propositions`, `reviewer`, and `rationale`.
A reviewer must confirm the atom is removed at every occurrence and every other proposition
is preserved, including shared subjects and qualifiers. Both validation booleans must be true.
The scorer checks that review is recorded and the original explanation and proposition match; it cannot
verify semantic preservation. Do not score edits that cannot satisfy these requirements.
